policy: Korean is canonical. Translations are display aids only. Never fabricate official English or Chinese names: a translation is shown only when its confidence is canonical/official/manual-derived/curated. Entries marked needs-verification or fallback are stored for review but render Korean. Visa/status codes (D-2, F-4, E-7, G-1, G-1-5, ...) are never translated.

integrated_application_form_34.en: Application Form (Report Form) — Annex Form No. 34
integrated_application_form_34.notes: English follows the bilingual heading printed on the official 별지 제34호 form (APPLICATION FORM (REPORT FORM)). Do not invent a Chinese official translation without a verified source.

foreign_resident_registration_card.notes: The card itself prints '외국인등록증 RESIDENCE CARD'. Older materials use 'Alien Registration Card (ARC)'. Needs one-time confirmation against current HiKorea English pages; no verified Chinese official name recorded.

extension_of_stay_permit.en: Permission to Extend Period of Stay
extension_of_stay_permit.notes: zh-CN value is a glossary candidate carried over from the repo template, which flags it as requiring native/legal QA — stored but not displayed. Must preserve permission/approval meaning (never 'automatic extension').

change_of_status_permit.en: Permission to Change Status of Stay
change_of_status_permit.notes: zh-CN value is a template candidate pending native/legal QA — stored but not displayed. Approval is discretionary; never render as guaranteed conversion.

activities_outside_status_permit.en: Permission to Engage in Activities Outside the Status of Stay
activities_outside_status_permit.notes: Descriptive English rendering of the stay-manual term; not presented as a statutory English title. No verified Chinese name recorded.

proof_of_place_of_stay.notes: Descriptive English only. The decorated DOC_DICT label doc_address ('체류지 입증서류 (임대차계약서, …)') is intentionally not linked to avoid annotating only part of a composite label.

accommodation_provision_confirmation.notes: Specific official form name — do not machine-translate. Renders Korean until an official/manual-derived English title is verified.

standard_admission_letter.notes: English candidate widely used by Korean universities, but not yet verified against an official bilingual source — stored, renders Korean.

certificate_for_confirmation_of_visa_iss.notes: Both translations already shipped in the reviewed locale packs (procedureLabels). doc_cvi is not linked because its DOC_DICT label already embeds an English gloss.

visa.notes: Common safe vocabulary; already used throughout the reviewed en/zh-CN packs.

status_of_stay.notes: zh-CN value is a template candidate pending native/legal QA — stored but not displayed. Forbidden renderings: 'tourist visa', 'citizenship status', 'guaranteed visa'.

passport.notes: Common safe vocabulary. Composite DOC_DICT passport labels (원본/사본 variants) are intentionally not linked.

fee.notes: Common safe vocabulary; linked only to the bare 수수료 label, not the decorated fee labels with amounts.

hikorea.notes: Official service brand name; kept as the Latin brand in all locales.

korea_visa_portal.notes: English name is the portal's own branding. Chinese site naming not verified — renders Korean.
